SH010.prompt: Photorealistic, cinematic. Bright remodeled kitchen with white subway tile and a white quartz counter, morning sun from a window on the left. A single white shaker upper cabinet hangs visibly crooked on the wall, about two degrees out of level, its right door sagging lower than the left. the woman from the reference image (Maria, 39, shoulder-length straight black hair, cream cable-knit sweater, mid-blue jeans) stands two steps back, tilts her head to match the crooked cabinet, then crosses her arms and says with a small self-mocking laugh: "Close enough... right?" Slow handheld-smooth push-in, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft dust in the sunbeam. Ambient room tone, faint fridge hum. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos, no music.

SH020.prompt: Photorealistic macro close-up. A silver aluminium spirit level rests on top of a white cabinet. The green vial fills the center of the frame; the air bubble wobbles and settles clearly off-center, past the right line. 100mm macro lens, razor-thin focus on the vial, the wall behind melts into soft cream bokeh, warm morning light glinting on the aluminium. Locked-off camera. Quiet room tone, a tiny liquid slosh. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos, no music.

SH030.prompt: Photorealistic, cinematic. Inside a narrow entry hall with oak plank floors, the dark oak front door swings open, and bright daylight floods in around the man from the reference image (Daniel, 46, a strikingly sharp jutting jawline on a very wide strong neck, a tall razor-sculpted asymmetrical wedge of dense hair, a heavy charcoal boiled-wool overcoat with pagoda shoulders and mismatched horn toggles, a stiff upright white linen ruff under his jaw), who stands on the threshold holding a canvas tool bag.
